_comment: Stage A independent confirmation on a NEW membership instance (perm3), CERTIFIED level: every arm retrained on this host, zero reuse of archived embeddings. AUTHORIZED by the user in chat on 2026-10-19/20: '我给授权,同时按认证级做,同样每半个小时检查一次'. Cap 10 wall-clock hours. Thresholds/seeds/judgment rules identical to the v2 perm0 screen.
authorization_quote: 我给授权,同时按认证级做,同样每半个小时检查一次

reuse.note: certified level: RR/PP/PR all retrained here; archived perm0-screen embeddings are NOT read by training or evaluation

instance.name: perm3
instance.algorithm: single uniform node permutation consuming the real region-size histogram in ascending region-id order (same family as archived perm0/1/2)

PR.training: retrain induced_coeff_override (clique), seeds 0-4; PR-exact = PP-exact (identity verified 0.0 in outputs/operator_validation_stage_a.json)

RP.training: not trained (same as v2); exact identity RP=RR verified 0.0

exact_identity.statement: exact coefficients depend only on d_i=2+b_i (roadmap.rel unchanged), so M(perm3, real)_exact = M(perm3, perm3)_exact and M(real, perm3)_exact = M(real, real)_exact

probe.readout: MAE of speed from the frozen ridge_a1 probe
probe.split: KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0) over non-NaN speed labels
probe.secondary_subset: perm3 movable roads (size>1 and >=2 regions of that size), continuity only

estimands.content_effect: Delta_content,s = E_RR,s - E_PR,s; mean and 95% t interval over 5 paired seeds
estimands.total_effect: Delta_total,s = E_RR,s - E_PP,s; additivity checked per seed

thresholds.interval: two-sided 95% t interval with 4 df over 5 paired seeds

cost.runs_detail: RR_exact x5, RR_clique x5, PP_exact x5, PP_clique x5, PR_clique x5 (seeds 0-4), plus 1 end-to-end bitwise reproduction check (RR_clique seed0 in a separate output dir)
cost.budget_basis: wall-clock cumulative; measured on this host during the perm0 screen (0.258-0.260 h/run)

certified_manifest.reproducibility_check: RR_clique seed0 rerun in an isolated output dir; embedding sha256 must match the original run bitwise, else all Stage A results are flagged determinism_suspect

stop_rules.meaningful_positive: content effect confirmed on an independent instance; proceed to Stage B (second instance or new city) only
stop_rules.meaningful_negative: direction reverses on the independent instance; the perm0 positive does not replicate; archive and merge into A3
stop_rules.negligible: CI entirely inside +/-0.01; perm0 positive does not replicate; archive and merge into A3
stop_rules.inconclusive: stop; do not add seeds/instances/models to chase a result
stop_rules.budget_exceeded: stop; report incomplete cells; do not extend or relax thresholds silently
stop_rules.run_failed: no retry; ledger and evidence preserved; user decides

claim_boundaries: Stage A is one new instance on the same Porto road network; passing it is replication within-city, not external validity (Stage B / new city needed).
Path decomposition remains path-dependent; RP is not trained.
Certified manifest covers this host's runs; it does not retroactively certify the archived perm0-screen exploratory reuse.
